dataInventory.fields: Authored Markdown, title/description/source metadata, rendered HTML, manifest, versions, localStorage decisions/comments
dataInventory.purpose: Create, reopen, version, and interact with a self-contained local artifact
dataInventory.recipientLocation: User-selected local filesystem and browser profile; no project telemetry recipient
dataInventory.retention: Until the user removes artifact, manifest/version files, and browser site data
dataInventory.deletion: Delete the artifact directory and relevant browser file-origin/site data; backups remain under the user's own policy

dataInventory.fields: Artifact bytes, comments, decisions, mini-DB documents, registered datasource output, local request metadata
dataInventory.purpose: Preview and local collaboration state on 127.0.0.1
dataInventory.recipientLocation: Local process, project artifact directory, and local browser
dataInventory.sensitivity: User-authored content and potentially sensitive command output
dataInventory.retention: Files persist until user deletion; transient request data lasts for process/request lifetime
dataInventory.deletion: Stop the service and delete .state/.db/datasource configuration and artifact files; remove browser site data separately

dataInventory.fields: Artifact/gallery bytes, manifest, git commits and repository metadata
dataInventory.purpose: Publish a public static snapshot selected by the user
dataInventory.controllerOperator: User or organization controlling the destination repository
dataInventory.recipientLocation: GitHub repository, Pages CDN/caches, and public viewers under GitHub terms
dataInventory.sensitivity: Public; secrets and private content are prohibited
dataInventory.retention: Repository history persists until operator action; forks, clones, caches, and backups may outlive deletion
dataInventory.deletion: Operator removes Pages content/history or repository and follows GitHub procedures; global erasure is not guaranteed

dataInventory.fields: Artifact/gallery bytes, Worker configuration, KV decisions/comments/mini-DB documents, provider request metadata
dataInventory.purpose: Publish a user-operated Worker and retain interactive state
dataInventory.controllerOperator: User or organization controlling the Cloudflare account
dataInventory.recipientLocation: Selected Cloudflare account, edge network, KV, caches/logs under the account plan and provider terms
dataInventory.sensitivity: Public by default; KV state may contain viewer-authored content
dataInventory.retention: Until operator deletes Worker/KV data, subject to provider cache, log, and backup schedules
dataInventory.deletion: Operator deletes Worker, KV namespace/keys, routes and provider logs where available; project cannot guarantee provider-wide erasure

dataInventory.fields: Planned audience policy, viewer identity/roles, sessions, comments/state, audit and administrative events
dataInventory.deletion: Not implemented; no current product claim

dataInventory.fields: Planned viewer grants, provider identity, query parameters/results, cache and audit metadata
dataInventory.sensitivity: Potentially private third-party data and credentials
dataInventory.deletion: Not implemented; no current product claim

dataInventory.fields: Pseudonymous code, categorical eligibility/conflict, consent/withdrawal, versions/platform, bounded timings, synthetic-fixture answers and scores
dataInventory.purpose: Measure Phase 0 first-use and comprehension outcomes
dataInventory.controllerOperator: Study maintainer named in the dated private record
dataInventory.recipientLocation: Access-controlled maintainer storage; anonymous aggregate in repository
dataInventory.sensitivity: Pseudonymous research record; direct identity and private artifact content prohibited
dataInventory.retention: Raw data until 30 days after aggregate acceptance; anonymous aggregate retained as decision history
dataInventory.deletion: Delete raw record immediately on timely withdrawal and delete all raw data at retention deadline

dataInventory.fields: Commit/tag/digest, tool/platform versions, test outputs, public fixtures/screenshots, pseudonymous failure summaries
dataInventory.purpose: Verify release claims and retain decision history
dataInventory.recipientLocation: Public repository and CI/provider logs, except explicitly private raw inputs
dataInventory.sensitivity: Public technical evidence; secrets, identities, private artifacts and vulnerability details prohibited
dataInventory.retention: Retained with release decision history; reviewed when a source or claim changes
dataInventory.deletion: Remove unauthorized/private material promptly while preserving a redacted correction and decision record
